donor.role: Directional face attachment, profile temple and rear hook visibility; donor rectangular heavy frame is replaced by Qud thin wire cups and almond glass.

design: Two almond glass lenses in thin wire rims, small bridge, simple temple wires/hooks and restrained glass glints. Profile lens is edge-on; no dark opaque sunglasses, round monocle, pupils, hair or broad strap.

palette.assignment: Pale native frame with separate white lens glints; neutral RGB/alpha source before tint.

depth: Keep complete physical frames and transparent glass. Original head overlays hidden rear frame surfaces; front/profile are near-side equipment above head.
mutations: Unmutated older-human base only. Irudad mutation-body and full NPC outfit remain unfinished; this actual ordinary Face/0 binding does not complete them.
